description: This file defines classes and data structures related to hardware modules in Android's audio policy framework, including HwModule and HwModuleCollection, with methods for managing audio devices, profiles, and routes.

classes.name: HwModule
classes.description: Represents an audio hardware module with profiles, devices, and routes management.

classes.name: HwModuleCollection
classes.description: A collection of HwModule instances with methods to retrieve and manage hardware modules and devices.

methods.name: getModuleFromName
methods.description: Retrieves a hardware module by its name.

methods.name: getModuleForDeviceType
methods.description: Finds a module supporting a specific device type and format.

methods.name: getModuleForDevice
methods.description: Finds a module supporting a specific device descriptor.

methods.name: getAvailableDevicesFromModuleName
methods.description: Returns available devices from a specified module.

methods.name: getDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Returns a device descriptor matching type and address, optionally creating it.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a new device descriptor for a given type and address.

methods.name: cleanUpForDevice
methods.description: Removes a device from all profiles and modules.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the state of the module collection.
